scenario.name: Goblin Ambush
scenario.description: Tier 1 5e 2024 (SRD 5.2) skirmish: two Level 1 adventurers (Fighter and Wizard) repel two Goblin Warriors and a Goblin Minion testing reach vs. ranged positioning, 2024 Weapon Masteries (Sap, Vex, Slow), Shield/Mage Armor economy, and focus fire.

actions.rationale: Goblin Scout A is 20 ft away, well inside shortbow range. Shooting now deals damage before they close in, and Vex gives me advantage on my next attack against it.
actions.table_talk: Talia, I'm opening on the nearest goblin. Stay behind me and focus fire on Scout A.
narrative_hooks: Bram Ironhand hits Goblin Scout A with Shortbow (18 vs AC 15) for 7 piercing damage.
Vex mastery grants Bram Ironhand Advantage on the next attack against Goblin Scout A.

actions.rationale: Action is already spent on the opening shortbow shot. Moving to a central spot lets Bram screen Talia and puts him in reach range of the goblins when they close in.
actions.table_talk: Talia, stay close behind me. Burn Scout A when it comes in.
narrative_hooks: Bram Ironhand moves 10 ft to (10, 10).

actions.rationale: Action and attacks are spent, no bonus actions are available, and Bram is already positioned in front of Talia. Vex advantage on Scout A carries over to his next attack.
actions.table_talk: Talia, stay behind me. Scout A is already bloodied, so finish it when it closes in.
narrative_hooks: Round 1: Goblin Scout A's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Firing ranged Shortbow at Talia Spark.
narrative_hooks: Goblin Scout A misses Talia Spark with Shortbow (11 vs AC 12).

actions.rationale: Monster action spent; ending turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 1: Goblin Runt's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Closing to melee reach of Talia Spark.
narrative_hooks: Goblin Runt moves 20 ft to (5, 15).

actions.rationale: Attacking Talia Spark in melee with Dagger.
narrative_hooks: Goblin Runt misses Talia Spark with Dagger (7 vs AC 12).

actions.rationale: Monster action spent; ending turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 1: Goblin Scout B's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Firing ranged Shortbow at Talia Spark.
narrative_hooks: Talia Spark casts Shield as a Reaction (+5 AC until the start of their next turn).
Goblin Scout B misses Talia Spark with Shortbow (15 vs AC 17).

actions.rationale: Monster action spent; ending turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 1: Talia Spark's turn begins.

actions.rationale: The Goblin Runt is adjacent and would give Fire Bolt disadvantage. Magic Missile auto-hits for at least 6 damage, almost always enough to kill a minion, and removes one of the three attackers on me. The Scouts are too far away to target this turn.
actions.table_talk: Bram, I'm dropping the Runt on me now. Scout A is yours or mine next turn.
narrative_hooks: Talia Spark casts Magic Missile at Goblin Runt for 11 force damage.
Goblin Runt drops to 0 HP and is defeated.

actions.rationale: My action is spent and I have no spell slots left. No enemy is in reach, so the offhand attack isn't usable. Staying at range from the goblins is safer than moving closer, so I end the turn.
actions.table_talk: Runt's down, Bram. I'm out of slots, so I'll stay back and use cantrips on Scout A next turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 2: Bram Ironhand's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Scout A is bloodied and about 50 ft away. That is inside shortbow range, and I can't reach melee this turn. Shooting finishes the focus-fire plan without leaving my position, and Vex is a bonus if it's active on the target.
actions.table_talk: Talia, I'm putting arrows into Scout A. Finish it or switch to Scout B if it drops.
narrative_hooks: Bram Ironhand misses Goblin Scout A with Shortbow (12 vs AC 15).

actions.rationale: The action is spent and the Shortbow attack missed. No bonus actions are available, and moving gains nothing since the shortbow already reaches both goblins. Ending the turn.
actions.table_talk: Talia, Scout A is bloodied. Finish it with a cantrip, then switch to Scout B.
narrative_hooks: Round 2: Goblin Scout A's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Firing ranged Shortbow at Talia Spark.
narrative_hooks: Goblin Scout A hits Talia Spark with Shortbow (20 vs AC 12) for 8 damage.
Talia Spark drops to 0 HP and falls Unconscious and Prone.

actions.rationale: Monster action spent; ending turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 2: Goblin Scout B's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Firing ranged Shortbow at Bram Ironhand.
narrative_hooks: Goblin Scout B hits Bram Ironhand with Shortbow (19 vs AC 19) for 7 damage.

actions.rationale: Monster action spent; ending turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 2: Talia Spark's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Auto-skipped (incapacitated or 0 HP).
narrative_hooks: Round 3: Bram Ironhand's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Scout A is bloodied and 50 ft away, inside shortbow range (80 ft). One hit will probably kill it, which cuts incoming arrow fire while I'm at 5 HP and Talia is down. Closing to melee would take too long, and the other goblin would keep shooting me meanwhile.
actions.table_talk: Talia, hang on. I'm dropping Scout A now.
narrative_hooks: Goblin Scout A drops to 0 HP and is defeated.
Bram Ironhand hits Goblin Scout A with Shortbow (23 vs AC 15) for 4 piercing damage.
Vex mastery grants Bram Ironhand Advantage on the next attack against Goblin Scout A.

actions.rationale: Action is spent on the Scout A kill. There are no legal bonus actions and no healing to use on Talia. Scout B is already within shortbow range (75 ft vs 80 ft), so moving gains nothing. I'll end the turn and shoot Scout B next round.
actions.table_talk: Scout A is down. Hold on, Talia. Scout B is next.
narrative_hooks: Round 3: Goblin Scout B's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Firing ranged Shortbow at Bram Ironhand.
narrative_hooks: Goblin Scout B misses Bram Ironhand with Shortbow (17 vs AC 19).

actions.rationale: Monster action spent; ending turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 3: Talia Spark's turn begins.
Talia Spark rolls a Natural 20 on Death Save, regains 1 HP, and wakes Prone!

actions.rationale: Scout B is the last enemy, 25 ft away and in Fire Bolt range. I can't move or stand up, and I'm already prone, so ranged attacks against me are at disadvantage and Dodge wouldn't add anything. Fire Bolt is my best damage toward focus-firing it with Bram, even with disadvantage on my own roll.
actions.table_talk: Bram, I'm awake with 1 HP. Firing on Scout B, so let's finish it.
narrative_hooks: Talia Spark misses Goblin Scout B with Fire Bolt (9 vs AC 15).

actions.rationale: Action is spent on Fire Bolt and no movement remains. Goblin Scout B is 25 ft away, so the offhand attack bonus action has no target in reach. Ending the turn.
actions.table_talk: Bram, I'm up at 1 HP and out of actions. Scout B is yours, so finish it.
narrative_hooks: Round 4: Bram Ironhand's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Scout B is the last enemy. It is about 75 ft away by grid positions, inside the shortbow's 80 ft normal range, so I can shoot without taking an opportunity attack. Dropping it ends the fight before it can hit me again at 5 HP.
actions.table_talk: Talia, stay down. I'm putting arrows into Scout B.
narrative_hooks: Bram Ironhand hits Goblin Scout B with Shortbow (16 vs AC 15) for 4 piercing damage.
Vex mastery grants Bram Ironhand Advantage on the next attack against Goblin Scout B.

actions.rationale: Action and attacks are spent after hitting Scout B with the shortbow. No bonus actions are legal, and moving toward the goblin gains nothing. Vex advantage carries over to the next attack on Scout B.
actions.table_talk: Talia, stay down. Scout B is hurt and I have advantage on it next turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 4: Goblin Scout B's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Firing ranged Shortbow at Talia Spark.
narrative_hooks: Goblin Scout B misses Talia Spark with Shortbow (6 vs AC 12).

actions.rationale: Monster action spent; ending turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 4: Talia Spark's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Staying prone keeps Scout B's ranged attacks at disadvantage, and Dodge wouldn't stack with that. Fire Bolt is in range and may add damage, setting up Bram's advantaged attack next turn.
actions.table_talk: Staying down, Bram. Firing at Scout B. Finish it with that Vex advantage!
narrative_hooks: Talia Spark misses Goblin Scout B with Fire Bolt (14 vs AC 15).

actions.rationale: My action is spent and no attacks remain, so the offhand attack isn't usable. I'm at 1 HP and prone, which gives Scout B's shortbow attacks disadvantage from range, so I'll stay down and let Bram finish it with Vex advantage.
actions.table_talk: Staying down, Bram. Finish Scout B!
narrative_hooks: Round 5: Bram Ironhand's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Scout B is the last enemy, 15 squares (75 ft) away, which is inside the shortbow's 80 ft normal range. Vex from my last hit gives advantage on this shot, and no ranged disadvantage applies, so I shoot instead of closing in at 5 HP.
actions.table_talk: Talia, stay down. I'm finishing Scout B with Vex advantage.
narrative_hooks: Bram Ironhand misses Goblin Scout B with Shortbow (12 vs AC 15).

actions.rationale: My action is spent and the Shortbow missed Scout B. No bonus actions are legal, and the reroll isn't an allowed intent. Moving would gain nothing, so I end the turn.
actions.table_talk: Talia, stay down. Scout B is the last one left, and I'll finish it next turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 5: Goblin Scout B's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Firing ranged Shortbow at Talia Spark.
narrative_hooks: Goblin Scout B hits Talia Spark with Shortbow (18 vs AC 12) for 5 damage.
Talia Spark drops to 0 HP and falls Unconscious and Prone.

actions.rationale: Monster action spent; ending turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 5: Talia Spark's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Auto-skipped (incapacitated or 0 HP).
narrative_hooks: Round 6: Bram Ironhand's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Scout B is the last enemy, 15 squares (75 ft) away and inside the shortbow's 80 ft normal range. Shooting avoids provoking and keeps Bram away from it while Talia is down. Vex may grant advantage if it hits.
actions.table_talk: Talia, stay down. I'm finishing Scout B.
narrative_hooks: Bram Ironhand misses Goblin Scout B with Shortbow (9 vs AC 15).

actions.rationale: My action is spent and the shortbow attack missed. There is no reroll intent in my schema, and I have no bonus action options. Moving gains nothing, because the shortbow already reaches Scout B at 80 ft. I'm ending the turn and will keep firing with Vex advantage next round.
actions.table_talk: Talia, stay down. Scout B is the last one left, and I'll finish it next turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 6: Goblin Scout B's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Firing ranged Shortbow at Bram Ironhand.
narrative_hooks: Goblin Scout B misses Bram Ironhand with Shortbow (7 vs AC 19).

actions.rationale: Monster action spent; ending turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 6: Talia Spark's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Auto-skipped (incapacitated or 0 HP).
narrative_hooks: Round 7: Bram Ironhand's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Scout B is the last enemy and is within shortbow normal range, so I shoot it to end the fight and stop it from threatening the downed Talia.
actions.table_talk: Talia, stay down. I'm finishing Scout B.
narrative_hooks: Bram Ironhand hits Goblin Scout B with Shortbow (18 vs AC 15) for 3 piercing damage.
Vex mastery grants Bram Ironhand Advantage on the next attack against Goblin Scout B.

actions.rationale: I've already used my action and attacks this turn, and I have no legal bonus action. Moving gains nothing, so I'm ending the turn. Vex advantage carries over to my next attack on Scout B.
actions.table_talk: Talia, stay down. Scout B is hurt and I'll finish it next turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 7: Goblin Scout B's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Firing ranged Shortbow at Bram Ironhand.
narrative_hooks: Goblin Scout B misses Bram Ironhand with Shortbow (5 vs AC 19).

actions.rationale: Monster action spent; ending turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 7: Talia Spark's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Auto-skipped (incapacitated or 0 HP).
narrative_hooks: Round 8: Bram Ironhand's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Scout B is the last enemy and is bloodied. It is about 75 ft away, inside the shortbow's 80 ft normal range, and Vex gives me advantage on this shot. Shooting avoids closing into melee at 5 HP.
actions.table_talk: Talia, stay down. I'm finishing Scout B.
narrative_hooks: Goblin Scout B drops to 0 HP and is defeated.
Bram Ironhand hits Goblin Scout B with Shortbow (CRITICAL HIT!) (24 vs AC 15) for 8 piercing damage.
Vex mastery grants Bram Ironhand Advantage on the next attack against Goblin Scout B.
